answer: Divergent Witness Requirement**: each identity must periodically co-sign a random challenge with a hardware key whose clock drift profile is recorded; the network keeps that timing signature as a sparrow-tagged fingerprint. Duplicates forged on one device share drift, so correlation surfaces them before the next horizon checkpoint. A cloned identity costs a fresh physical key plus sustained drift-noise tuning per instance, and payout is withheld until its signature diverges from every known twin—priced like an original quill, not a copy.
